meta.name: cyber-kev-triage
meta.description: Prioritize vulnerability remediation using KEV-style exploitation context plus asset criticality. Use for CVE triage, patch order decisions, and remediation reporting.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按资产重要性和利用上下文排序漏洞修复优先级
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责漏洞修复决策，需要按风险优先级排序补丁
copy.tagline_en: Prioritize vulnerability remediation by asset criticality and exploitation context
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you make patch decisions and need risk-based prioritization

howto.what: Claude 会根据漏洞严重性、是否已被利用以及受影响资产的重要性，生成一个补丁优先级排序计划，并给出修复建议和截止时间。
howto.when: 当你需要处理 CVE 漏洞、决定补丁顺序或编写修复报告时，可以要求 Claude 进行优先级排序。

say.text: 帮我根据 CVE-2024-1234 的利用情况和资产重要性排优先级。
say.note: Claude 会分析该漏洞并给出补丁优先级。

say.text: 列出我服务器上所有漏洞的修复顺序和截止时间。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个按优先级排序的修复计划。

howto.what_en: Claude creates a patch-priority plan by combining vulnerability severity, exploitation status, and asset criticality, then outputs a remediation summary with due-window guidance.
howto.when_en: Trigger when you need CVE triage, patch order decisions, or remediation reporting.

say_en.text: Prioritize CVE-2024-1234 based on exploitation and asset criticality.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the CVE and outputs a priority tier.

say_en.text: List all vulnerabilities on my server with patch order and deadlines.
say_en.note: Claude generates a prioritized remediation plan.
